title: W42-S2 Feature Set -> File Subset Contract
description: Pure-contract schema. DATA / SPEC ONLY: it describes inputs and expected outputs of a resolver that does NOT exist yet (implementation belongs to S3+). Nothing here asserts any capability, any hash, or any engine behaviour. Consumes W38-S1 VERSION_GUARD_CONTRACT.md ($id .../w38-s1/version-guard.json) for guard_state / write entry enums; does NOT redefine them.

guardState.description: IMPORTED verbatim from W38-S1 guardVerdict.state (all four states, DIR_INVALID included -- verified against EVIDENCE/guard_contract_schema.json by s2_shape_check.py B17.2a). Not redefined.

mapFileName.description: Bare *.MAP name, no path separators. v11 package_files() globs '*.MAP' (install.py:719).

csfLabel.description: Stable label emitted by builder.csf_label_for() = RA2F:<8-hex-sha256-prefix> (builder.py:400-415).

map_files.description: Exact *.MAP set this campaign ships. Feeds mix.source_map_set and mapselmd Scenario= alignment.

chain.description: NextScenario chain (W36 §3.3.3 G3). Referenced, not re-derived.

mode.description: MUTEX: 'append' (v11 BATTLEMD98.INI additive loose) vs 'inplace' (legacy BATTLEMD.INI overwrite) are mutually exclusive. A single value is the only legal form; an ARRAY of >=2 distinct modes is a legal INPUT SHAPE for rejection tests but MUST be refused by the resolver (reason_code BATTLEMD_MODE_CONFLICT). This is how the contract encodes 'inplace 与 append 不可同时'.

ids.description: Battle IDs written into the INI. W36 §3.3.1 example field.

description_ref.description: raw = builder's raw-text Description=; csf_label = builder.py:131-137 rewrites Description= to RA2F:<8hex>. csf_label REQUIRES csf.mode=clone_append (G2 / W30 MISSING:RA2F:... ).

source_map_set.description: MUST be byte-identical (same ordered set) to maps.map_files. v11 builder.py:143-147 builds expandmd98.mix from the same map_texts; _verify_mix_contents forces exactly maps, 0 INI.

mode.description: 'off' == the task-card example's 'none'. clone_append = clone the COMPLETE official ra2md.csf then append our label (W30 CSF_CAPABILITY.md:41-45).

base.description: FULL-CLONE INTEGRITY GATE. 'minimal' (only our label / few labels) MUST be refused: reason_code MINIMAL_CSF_REFUSED. v11 csf.py has NO such gate (append_or_set_label create_if_missing=True, csf.py:442-466) -- this is a NEW contract rule, not a present capability.

official_label_count.description: Observed label count of the cloned base. W38 C10 / W36 §3.1.1 cite official ra2md.csf = 5211 labels [转引]. The contract threshold is >= official_full_min (5211 [转引·待运行验证]); a base with only our label fails.

labels.description: Our appended labels only; must NOT be the whole file.

then.description: SHAPE ONLY: base may be 'official_full_clone' OR 'minimal'. The resolver (couplingRuleSet K4) refuses 'minimal' with MINIMAL_CSF_REFUSED. Do NOT const-force base here.

mode.description: 'off' == task-card 'none'. clone_append = byte-exact clone of the COMPLETE official MAPSELMD.INI (14 stages, 5573 B) + appended stages (W34 D4).

base.description: FULL-CLONE INTEGRITY GATE. 'partial_or_minimal' MUST be refused: reason_code MAPSELMD_NOT_FULL_CLONE. v11 mapselmd.validate_official_base() (mapselmd.py:142-184) already enforces 14 stages / 1..7 keys / Scenario= / >=1000 B.

bundled_official_sha256.description: [本次读码] mapselmd.py:60-62 OFFICIAL_SHA256 of bundled MAPSELMD.OFFICIAL.INI. A base failing this (when the bundled clone is used) is refused.

stages.description: Appended stage section names. Every stage's Scenario= MUST resolve to a name in maps.map_files (W36 §3.3.2 strong pair).

then.description: SHAPE ONLY: base may be 'official_full_clone' OR 'partial_or_minimal'; counts/size may be off. The resolver (couplingRuleSet K5) refuses partial_or_minimal / wrong 14-stage-5573B-SHA with MAPSELMD_NOT_FULL_CLONE. Do NOT const-force them here.

featureSet.description: SHAPE ONLY. This schema validates structure/types/enums; it deliberately does NOT enforce coupling, mutex or integrity constraints, so that NEGATIVE inputs (minimal CSF, partial MAPSELMD clone, csf-without-battlemd, dual battlemd modes) remain expressible as inputs and are REFUSED by the resolver per couplingRuleSet, not rejected by a JSON validator. Enforcing them here would make those negative acceptance cases unrepresentable.

feature_set_id.description: Stable id of THIS combination. Feeds W36 §3.3.3 G4: any subset change changes package_digest / seal / manifest / backup / uninstall -- a different feature_set_id.

csf_out_path.description: E2b write point from 'build --csf-out PATH' (builder.py:434-437, WRITE_ENTRY_AUDIT.tsv rows 11-13/18-22). If realpath(PATH) resolves inside any game dir, W38-S1 §1.2 path-attribution rule reclassifies it as E1 (ACCEPTANCE A7).

closed_features_byte_identical_to.description: W36 §4-S2 acceptance #2: all-off build is byte-identical to the previous tool version.

fileAction.description: CREATE = initial state ABSENT, our install creates it (original_absent=true) -> uninstall MUST DELETE, never restore. REPLACE = initial state PRESENT, install backs up to <name>.ra2forge.bak then atomically overwrites -> uninstall MUST RESTORE. LEAVE = not touched by this feature set at all: NO write, NO backup, NO delete. NOTE: LEAVE is NOT v11's action='unchanged' (install.py:1290-1301) which ADOPTS a byte-identical unregistered file and later DELETES it; LEAVE is strictly zero-touch.

original_absent.description: W21 ORPHAN-FIX01 / install.py:1360-1368, 2335-2370. true <=> sandbox initial state has NO original of this name. Drives DELETE-not-RESTORE.

s2ReasonCode.description: S2-specific reason codes. ORTHOGONAL to W38-S1 guardVerdict.reason_codes: these describe feature-set/coupling refusal, NOT build-identity refusal. A resolver may emit both sets; guard_state is unchanged by any of these.

source.description: W36 §3.3.2 cell / W34 D4 / W30 §1 / file:line this rule is derived from.

kind.description: official_loose e.g. BATTLEMD.INI 2733 B [转引·题面本次实测]; bundled_in_mix = same-named file inside ra2md.mix/langmd.mix, NOT a loose file (W38 C09/C10, W30/W34 UNCOVERED 散装 vs MIX 生效未真机定谳).

absent_files.description: Names with NO loose original. Any feature shipping such a name yields CREATE + original_absent=true + uninstall DELETE.

game_process_count.description: Pure-offline discipline: inert gamemd.exe placeholder only, never executed (W34 UNCOVERED U9).

digest_inputs.description: W36 G4 / install.py:682-695 package_digest_from_steps(): one '<name> <sha256>' line per shipped file, sorted by name. Subset change => different line set => different digest => different seal/manifest/backup/uninstall.

then.description: W38-S1 §4 cross-state invariant + §6.1 invariant 1. Feature set changes the PLANNED write-point set ONLY; it never changes the guard verdict. Under UNKNOWN/MISMATCH the S1 decision table still forces zero game-dir writes.
